# model.getTimer

<div class="api-badges"><span class="api-badge api-badge--since">since 1.1.0</span></div>

Return a timer by name or by index.

```lua
model.getTimer(Name)
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Name` | string | yes | or Index (integer) |

## Returns

timer

## Examples

```lua
local t = model.getTimer(0)                        -- first timer (or by name: model.getTimer("Flight"))
if t then
  print(t:name(), t:stringValue(), t:running())
  if not t:running() then t:reset() end
end
```

Returns `nil` when the timer doesn't exist. See the [timer recipe](../../cookbook/timer-control.md).

```lua title="From the official Ethos documentation"
local timer = model.getTimer("Test")
local timer = model.getTimer(0)
```
